_what: How the page's requests wait for each other, read by src/workspace/request-classes.ts. A request is in the first class whose `match` holds (methods; path prefixes), else the `default` class. `concurrency` is the most requests of that class in flight at once (null: no limit). `yield_to` lists classes in flight that a request of this class waits for, so a stop, send or approval is never queued behind catalogue and list reads. Out of the box background reads wait only for writes in flight and for their own limit.
